Description.Danish: We would be most grateful if you would take the time to answer the following additional questions.
Description.English: We would be most grateful if you would take the time to answer the following additional questions.

Title.Danish: Please let us know what you think about the problem sets.
Title.English: Please let us know what you think about the problem sets.

Title.Danish: It is good to have as a requirement that students should pass problem sets to be allowed to take the exam.
Title.English: It is good to have as a requirement that students should pass problem sets to be allowed to take the exam.

Title.Danish: Working on the problem sets was a useful learning experience.
Title.English: Working on the problem sets was a useful learning experience.

Title.Danish: The grading of and feedback on the problem sets was understandable.
Title.English: The grading of and feedback on the problem sets was understandable.

Title.Danish: I was able to work on the problems on my own without using generative AI
Title.English: I was able to work on the problems on my own without using generative AI

Title.Danish: How was the level of difficulty of the problem sets in your opinion?
Title.English: How was the level of difficulty of the problem sets in your opinion?

Title.Danish: Please let us know a little bit more about how you approached the problem sets.
Title.English: Please let us know a little bit more about how you approached the problem sets.

Title.Danish: How much did you collaborate with other students when working on the problem sets?
Title.English: How much did you collaborate with other students when working on the problem sets?

Title.Danish: How much did you search for information and/or solutions on the internet while working on the problem sets?
Title.English: How much did you search for information and/or solutions on the internet while working on the problem sets?

Title.Danish: How much did you use generative AI / chatbots to understand the problem statements for problems on the problem sets?
Title.English: How much did you use generative AI / chatbots to understand the problem statements for problems on the problem sets?

Title.Danish: How much did you use generative AI / chatbots for actually generating solutions to the problem sets?
Title.English: How much did you use generative AI / chatbots for actually generating solutions to the problem sets?

Title.Danish: Given that modern generative AI can easily solve problem sets on introductory CS courses, do you think it is a good idea to have compulsory hand-in assignments?
Title.English: Given that modern generative AI can easily solve problem sets on introductory CS courses, do you think it is a good idea to have compulsory hand-in assignments?

Title.Danish: Did you find the exercise classes helpful?
Title.English: Did you find the exercise classes helpful?

Title.Danish: Do you have any suggestions for aspects of the exercise classes that should be changed, or should stay the same?
Title.English: Do you have any suggestions for aspects of the exercise classes that should be changed, or should stay the same?

Title.Danish: Do you have any concrete feedback for the TA(s) whose exercise classes you attended? Please use the given name of the TA if you want them to be able to know about feedback directed specifically to them.
Title.English: Do you have any concrete feedback for the TA(s) whose exercise classes you attended? Please use the given name of the TA if you want them to be able to know about feedback directed specifically to them.

Title.Danish: How did you find the pace of Jakob's lectures? Was the speed too low, suitable, or too high?
Title.English: How did you find the pace of Jakob's lectures? Was the speed too low, suitable, or too high?

Title.Danish: How was the material covered in Jakob's lectures? Did you find it interesting?
Title.English: How was the material covered in Jakob's lectures? Did you find it interesting?

Title.Danish: Do you have any other feedback to Jakob as a lecturer?
Title.English: Do you have any other feedback to Jakob as a lecturer?

Title.Danish: How did you find the pace of Amir's lectures? Was the speed too low, suitable, or too high?
Title.English: How did you find the pace of Amir's lectures? Was the speed too low, suitable, or too high?

Title.Danish: How was the material covered in Amir's lectures? Did you find it interesting?
Title.English: How was the material covered in Amir's lectures? Did you find it interesting?

Title.Danish: Do you have any other feedback to Amir as a lecturer?
Title.English: Do you have any other feedback to Amir as a lecturer?

Title.Danish: Do you have any other comments or suggestions regarding aspects of the lectures that should be changed, or that should stay the same?
Title.English: Do you have any other comments or suggestions regarding aspects of the lectures that should be changed, or that should stay the same?

Title.Danish: Some other courses have or have had study cafes, but IDMA did not have study cafes this year. Do you think that having study cafes would have been helpful?
Title.English: Some other courses have or have had study cafes, but IDMA did not have study cafes this year. Do you think that having study cafes would have been helpful?

Title.Danish: Do you have any creative (and realistic) ideas for how the IDMA course could be made better?
Title.English: Do you have any creative (and realistic) ideas for how the IDMA course could be made better?
